manifest.notes: Intended for Sepolia. Deploy src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken with no constructor arguments, then src/SavingsCircle.sol:SavingsCircle with the deployed CIRC address. SavingsCircle stores that address immutably, requires no initial CIRC balance, and has no owner or initialization calls. Members obtain CIRC through the factory-seeded native ETH pool; application bonds, contributions and withdrawals use CIRC. The pool has no hook. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96; services derive the effective opening price from policy when configured. Policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services. The default-profit counterexamples involving carry and the all-default fallback documented in docs/REVIEW.md remain unresolved review findings. This manifest does not constitute deployment approval.
